"EXPLORATORY DEMO ONLY; NOT VERIFIED FIELD METADATA. All source/receiver elevations are assumed 0 m, not measured. Coordinate uncertainties are set to 0 m only to omit geometric uncertainty from this model, not to claim perfect positioning. One unstacked hit per file and stored samples in V are hypotheses; original STACK=0 is retained. Channel-to-receiver correspondence follows SEG-2 CHANNEL_NUMBER and trace order, not an independent survey. TRS first-arrival exploration; no verified geological model or temporal calibration. The post-signal noise reference window is assumed signal-free, not validated in the field. User confirms vertical geophones, DAQLink 4, hammer switch, no pretrigger, and F1 at x=-15 m before receiver 1; receiver spacing 5 m comes from field notes."
